frames.title: Lesson 85 · Perfect participle passive — production and review

body: **Foco:** Perfect participle passive — produção e revisão.
**Pronúncia:** Ênfase intencional.
**22 palavras novas** (comunicação intercultural).
**Texto do dia:** biografia.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo produzir uma biografia curta com having been + particípio e revisar a forma e o sujeito.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.name: Amara Okoye (fictional interpreter)
paras: **Having been raised** in a bilingual household, Amara Okoye could switch between languages before she could read. **Having been rejected** by her first-choice university, she trained at night while working as a guide. **Not having been trusted** with major assignments at first, she volunteered for hospital interpreting.

**Having been recognized** for her calm under pressure, she was chosen to interpret at an international peace forum. **Having been asked** about her secret, she says: “I listen twice as much as I speak.”

items.q: Amara grew up speaking one language.
She says she speaks twice as much as she listens.

blocks.body: Na produção, revise três coisas: **forma** (having been), **sujeito** (o mesmo) e **tempo** (anterior).
✗ *Having been rejected, the job was lost.* (sujeito errado).

items.s: ___ been raised abroad, she spoke two languages. (Having)
Having been recognized, ___ was chosen to interpret. (she)
Having been rejected, she trained at ___ . (night)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Having been rejected how did you continue

body: **Against all odds,…** — Contra todas as probabilidades,…
**Rise through the ranks.** — Subir na carreira.
**Turn the tables.** — Virar o jogo.
**Find one’s voice.** — Encontrar a própria voz.
**Make a name for oneself.** — Fazer nome.
**Learn the ropes.** — Aprender o ofício.
**A steep learning curve.** — Uma curva de aprendizado íngreme.
**Stand one’s ground.** — Manter-se firme.
**Having been rejected, how did you continue?** — Tendo sido rejeitada, como continuou?
**What is your secret?** — Qual é o seu segredo?
**Having been told no once, I trained at night.** — Tendo ouvido não uma vez, treinei à noite.

blocks.title: Interview
lines: Having been rejected, how did you continue?
Having been told no once, I trained at night.
Tendo ouvido não uma vez, treinei à noite.
I listen twice as much as I speak.
Escuto duas vezes mais do que falo.

items.label: Ênfase intencional
items.note: Ênfase intencional: a palavra mais importante da frase recebe o acento mais forte e a nota mais alta, para marcar contraste ou correção.
words: It was the POLICY, not the person.
We need MORE time, not more money.

prompts.q: Tell a person’s story with having been.
prompts.model: Having been raised abroad, she spoke two languages.
Having been rejected, she tried again.
Having been rejected, she trained at night.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence mini-biography of a real or fictional person using having been + participle at least three times.
blocks.model: Having been born in a small town, Lia dreamed of traveling. Having been refused a scholarship, she worked for two years. Not having been discouraged, she applied again. Having been accepted at last, she moved to Lisbon. Having been trained as an interpreter, she now works at conferences.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
